title: Two more Bukidnon centenarians receive P50,000 cash incentives

blocks.text: DANGCAGAN, Bukidnon — Two more living centenarians in southern Bukidnon received P50,000 each in cash incentives from the provincial government on Wednesday, November 11, as part of its continuing recognition of the province’s oldest residents.
